about: Expected outputs of the formatters in public/index.html, produced by running that code in Node. Written by a capture script; do not edit by hand.
layout: cases[function] is a list of [arguments, result] rows. Time rows carry a third item, the time zone; tempStatus rows carry the dashboard colour.
special: A value written {"$": "NaN" | "Infinity" | "-Infinity" | "-0" | "undefined"} stands for that JavaScript value. Numeric results are {"bits": IEEE-754 hex, "str": String(x)}.
